title: 군검찰단의 조직에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Ministry of National Defense Prosecutors' Office)
(1) The prosecutors' office established under the Minister of National Defense pursuant to Article 36 (1) of the Military Court Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Ministry of National Defense Prosecutors' Office") shall administer affairs concerning military prosecutors and military prosecution under the Ministry of National Defense.
(2) The Ministry of National Defense Prosecutors' Office shall have a High Prosecution Division, an Ordinary Prosecution Division, a Human Rights Protection Supervisor and an Administrative Office.
(3) Matters necessary for the organization, jurisdiction and allocation of duties of the Ministry of National Defense Prosecutors' Office, other than those prescribed in paragraphs (1) and (2), shall be determined by the Minister of National Defense.
